choice.question: Someone is at the bottom door. What do you do?

lines.text: Imagine you keep the last lighthouse on this coast, and the boat home comes in seven days.
At 1:52 AM, the coast guard radio crackles on and reads you three rules.
lines.say: At one fifty-two a.m., the coast guard radio crackles on, and reads you three rules.

lines.text: That radio has been unplugged since the day you arrived.
Rule one. The lamp never goes out. Not for one second.
lines.speaker: uomo-radio

tv.title: COAST GUARD · CHANNEL 16
tv.ticker: COAST GUARD · CHANNEL 16 · RULE 1: THE LAMP NEVER GOES OUT · RULE 2: THE BOTTOM DOOR STAYS SHUT UNTIL SUNRISE · RULE 3: IF SOMEONE KNOCKS, LOOK UP FIRST · KEEP THE OIL CLOSE · WHATEVER YOU HEAR

lines.text: Rule two. The bottom door stays shut until sunrise.
lines.speaker: uomo-radio

tv.title: COAST GUARD · CHANNEL 16
tv.ticker: COAST GUARD · CHANNEL 16 · RULE 1: THE LAMP NEVER GOES OUT · RULE 2: THE BOTTOM DOOR STAYS SHUT UNTIL SUNRISE · RULE 3: IF SOMEONE KNOCKS, LOOK UP FIRST · KEEP THE OIL CLOSE · WHATEVER YOU HEAR

lines.text: Rule three. If someone knocks and says the lamp is out, look up first.
lines.speaker: uomo-radio

tv.ticker: COAST GUARD · CHANNEL 16 · RULE 1: THE LAMP NEVER GOES OUT · RULE 2: THE BOTTOM DOOR STAYS SHUT UNTIL SUNRISE · RULE 3: IF SOMEONE KNOCKS, LOOK UP FIRST · KEEP THE OIL CLOSE · WHATEVER YOU HEAR

lines.text: Good news. There's oil for all seven nights.

card.title: Oil for 7 nights
card.body: The lamp will burn until the boat comes.

lines.text: Bad news. The bolt on the bottom door is rusted through.
At 2:40 AM, three slow knocks come up the stairs.
lines.say: At two forty a.m., three slow knocks come up the stairs.

lines.text: Keeper! Your lamp's gone out! Let me in, I can't see the rocks!
lines.speaker: uomo-nervoso

lines.text: Above you, the lamp is turning, bright as ever.
Down below, the rusted bolt starts to bend.
But down on the rocks, a small lantern is blinking, like someone really needs help.
Open the door, or stay up with the lamp?
Your call. Comment OPEN or STAY.
